notes: REPORTS: one report centre with search, most-used reports, period presets and remembered choices. MONEY CONTROL: cash lodgement register and unbanked cash; VAT, NHIL and GETFund breakdown of tax-inclusive sales; accounts journal; targets against actual; sales year on year. FASTER BILLING: price list, quick bill, keyboard shortcuts, copy an invoice, recurring bills, reminders and statements in one run. SAFETY: backups protected with a passphrase; a go-live checklist on Home. Installing: the books are upgraded when the app opens; no figure changes. Take a backup first: Setup, Backup, Back up now.
